content.text:
No liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee provisions exist anywhere in this Agreement.

**Analysis of the only money-on-termination provision (p0016):** "Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement." This is not a liquidated damage or penalty — under the § 5 revenue-share model, Kubient collects from Advertisers and remits AP's share, so Kubient's "fees generated" are its share of revenue actually earned during the 90-day notice period. AP makes no out-of-pocket payment, and the amount is not a pre-estimate of loss triggered by breach. No minimum fee, no shortfall payment, no accelerated-fee clause. The Initial Term lock-in (no termination for convenience in year one) carries no associated fee, so it does not create a Customer-payable liquidated amount either.

Other provisions checked and cleared: § 7 limitation of liability excludes punitive damages mutually; § 14(d) prevailing-party fee-shifting is reciprocal litigation cost recovery, not an LD; § 13 expressly disclaims any minimum revenue guarantee running in either direction. AP's only payment obligations are taxes (§ 5) and indemnity (§ 10(b)) — neither is a stipulated-sum remedy.

input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination fee payable by AP, so the preferred position (no Customer-payable LD) is already met. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "shall pay" and "minimum" returned no Customer-payable stipulated-sum remedy, and a full read of all 75 paragraphs confirms none. The only money-on-termination provision, § 4(a), entitles Kubient to "all fees generated during the termination period" — under the § 5 revenue-share model Kubient collects from Advertisers and remits AP's share, so this is Kubient's share of revenue actually earned during the 90-day notice period rather than a pre-estimated sum payable by AP; it is also expressly disapplied where AP terminates for Kubient's material breach. The Initial Term lock-in in § 4(a) carries no associated fee. § 7 excludes punitive damages mutually, § 14(d) prevailing-party fee recovery is reciprocal and not an LD, and § 13 disclaims any minimum revenue guarantee for either Party. AP's only payment obligations are taxes (§ 5) and its indemnity (§ 10(b)), neither of which is a liquidated amount. No redline required.
